name: College Now
what_you_do: Take free college courses and college and career awareness classes from a CUNY campus while in high school, at your school, on a campus, online, or on Saturdays. Earn up to 15 college credits.
who_can_apply: Students at NYC public high schools. Grade 11 and 12 with an 80+ GPA can take courses on the partner campus, and a 70+ GPA opens some courses. Grade 10 with a 70+ GPA can take non-credit college and career awareness courses only. College Now is geared toward NYC Public Schools 11th and 12th graders.
pay_detail: Free. The CUNY page describes College Now as a FREE program.
deadline_text: Each campus sets its own deadline. CUNY says spring applications are typically available October to early February, summer March to June, and fall late March to mid-September.
how_to_apply: Apply to a specific CUNY campus's College Now program. Talk to your school's College Now liaison if your school has a partner campus, or contact a campus program directly. Many programs are first come, first served.
notes: Graduating seniors cannot join summer sessions. Students in Early College high schools can only join in summer. Costs beyond tuition (like textbooks) are not described on the CUNY page, so ask the campus.
